name: LiChessable
description: Shows Lichess opening-database statistics alongside Chessable's move table on Explore and Analysis pages, follows the board when browsing a completed variation in review or a standalone variation page, adds Overstudy shortcuts to review sessions, can auto-play moves you already answered correctly this session, logs every move you fail in a session and can either drill just those moves on its own board or walk you through their variations again as overstudy, lets you append a comment or an alternative move to a mainline move from the review browse panel or a variation page, offers to engine-check a wrong quiz answer and add it as an accepted alternative, can answer a quiz from a typed move instead of the mouse, lists which of a course's variations are still missing from one of your own repertoires (ranked by how likely you are to face them) and adds them in one press, lists the moves you get wrong that Chessable's Key Moves Only study mode would never ask you for and lowers each variation's key range to cover them (and puts it back once they are learned), sorts a chapter's variations into move-tree order with each branching point ranked by how often the move is played on Lichess, quizzes your judgement on positions from real games that carried on past the point one of your course lines stopped (gathering them in advance so a session starts at once, and carrying them to your other devices through your own course), mixes in tactics from real games that played one of your own lines, and offers optional local Stockfish analysis.
